findings.title: Each card-machine refund attempt gets a new idempotency key, so a retry can push a second refund to the card
findings.scenario: refundOnCardMachine() calls newIdempotencyKey() every time it runs (line ~145), and nothing checks for a refund already in flight on that payment. Example: a manager on /refunds refunds PKR 500 of a PKR 2,000 card-machine payment. Case 1: the POST /pos/terminal/refunds response is lost (network drop, Cloudflare 502). The UI shows an error and the manager taps Refund again. Case 2: the machine has not answered after 120 s. performRefund returns normally, onSuccess resets the form and shows 'not answered yet', and the manager re-selects the order and refunds 500 again. Either way the second call carries a fresh key. The server only blocks a refund larger than the payment minus refunds in flight (2000 - 500 >= 500), so it creates a second refund charge and pushes it to the machine. The guest gets PKR 1,000 back instead of 500. Spec §7.3 asks for one key per attempt, reused on retries, for exactly this reason.
findings.fix: Keep the refund key per attempt, as chargeKeyFor does: store it in sessionStorage under `refund:<paymentId>:<amountCents>` and drop it only when the refund ends with no money moved (declined, cancelled or expired). Before starting, look at the terminalChargesFor(orderId) result the function already fetches: if a refund on input.payment.id is in pending, sent, approved, cancel_requested or unknown, follow that charge instead of starting a new one. On /refunds, do not reset the form when the outcome is not final (terminalRefundText(...).ok === false while the status is not final). Say 'still in flight, do not refund again' and keep following.

findings.title: Reopening a ticket within 5 minutes does not resume the running card charge (resume query cached with staleTime: Infinity)
findings.scenario: `active` (queryKey ['pos','active-charge', order.id], line ~150) has staleTime Infinity. The modal unmounts on close (pos/page.tsx renders it conditionally, keyed per ticket), and the cached result stays for gcTime, which defaults to 5 minutes. Sequence: the cashier opens ticket T, the query caches [], they start a charge, the machine goes 'unknown' or is still waiting, and they close the modal. They reopen T from Open tickets 2 minutes later. The query does not refetch on mount, so resumeCharge is null, chargeBlocking is false, every tender is unlocked and the screen offers 'Charge PKR x' again. Spec §7.13 says closing or reloading resumes the charge, and the builder report says the same. The cashier can take cash on a bill the machine may already have charged. Before W4's TERMINAL_CHARGE_ACTIVE guard lands, nothing on the server stops the double payment. After it lands, the cashier gets a 409 instead of the resumed charge.
findings.fix: Fetch active charges fresh every time the modal opens: use `staleTime: 0, refetchOnMount: 'always'` (or `gcTime: 0`) on that query, or call qc.removeQueries({queryKey: ['pos','active-charge', id]}) in the modal's onClose. Keep `if (!configSettled)`-style gating so the card UI waits until the resume answer is in, and lock the method picker until then.

findings.title: The manual-reference link is hidden unless the machine reads offline, contrary to spec §7.2
findings.scenario: manualFallback = terminalOn && allowManualRef && (machineDown || terminal.online === false). Spec §7.2 says the collapsed link 'Card machine not working? Enter the machine reference' keeps today's gatewayRef path whenever allowManualRef is set. `online` is the health of terminals[0] only. machineDown is set only for TERMINAL_UNREACHABLE, TERMINAL_NOT_CONFIGURED or status 0. Example: the outlet's machine (or the second of two) has a dead card reader while the vendor API answers. Every charge ends 'expired' or 'declined', online stays true, and the link never appears. The cashier cannot record a card taken on a standalone or backup machine, even though the company allows manual references.
findings.fix: Show the collapsed link whenever terminalOn && terminal.allowManualRef && !chargeBlocking. Highlight it (keep the 'offline' wording) when machineDown or online === false. Also set machineDown after an 'expired' or 'declined' attempt on the chosen terminal, and refetch the terminal config after TERMINAL_NOT_CONFIGURED (see W3b-R6).

findings.title: The refund UI blocks refunds the server allows: pending digital rows of completed online orders are ignored
findings.scenario: refundTendersOf() counts only `status === 'paid'` rows. The server's refundableOf (pos/service.ts ~1962) also counts PENDING card or keenu_qr rows when an order with source != 'pos' has no paid receipt: 'a completed online order whose CARD / QR row the gateway never confirmed'. For such an order, RefundOptions shows 'Nothing was paid on this order — there is nothing to refund' and refundChoiceReady() returns false. The Refund button on /refunds and on the order page is disabled. The old page let this refund through and the server books it. It is now impossible from the UI.
findings.fix: Mirror the server rule. If no paid receipts exist and order.source !== 'pos', use pending rows with method card or keenu_qr as the tender base. Better, have the server return `refundableTenders` / `refundableCents` and render those, so the admin keeps no copy of the rule. This needs the order's `source` passed into refundTendersOf / RefundOptions.

findings.title: The tip can still be edited while a card charge is running, so the screen shows an amount the machine is not charging
findings.scenario: The tip input (tipsAccepted) stays enabled while TerminalCharge holds an active charge. The machine was sent due + old tip (charge.amountCents). If the cashier types a new tip, the modal shows 'Charge the card PKR (due + new tip)', and the tip goes into the TerminalCharge props but not into the running charge. The guest is told one total and charged another. The new tip is silently lost.
findings.fix: Disable the tip input while chargeBlocking, or while TerminalCharge has a charge. Show the tip from the charge view (charge.tipCents / amountCents) instead of the local input once a charge exists.

findings.title: After TERMINAL_NOT_CONFIGURED the till can be stuck with 'enter the reference' and no field to enter it
findings.scenario: The connector is switched off mid-shift. Start returns 503 TERMINAL_NOT_CONFIGURED, onMachineDown fires, and the message reads 'take the card on the machine and enter its reference'. The terminal config query is never refetched (staleTime 15 s, window-focus refetch off globally, nothing invalidates it), so terminalOn stays true and useTerminal stays true. If the company's stored allowManualRef was false, manualFallback is false and no reference field appears until the modal is reopened 15 s later or more. Separately, a failed poll sets an error (e.g. 'No connection to the server') that is never cleared when later polls succeed, so it stays on screen through an approved charge.
findings.fix: On TERMINAL_NOT_CONFIGURED, invalidate ['pos','terminal-config', shiftId]; the config then returns enabled:false and the manual path shows. In the poll effect, call setError(null) after a successful getTerminalCharge. Stop polling on a 403 or 404 instead of retrying forever.

findings.title: Held fiscal documents are shown as 'will file automatically'
findings.scenario: Spec §17.0: until the CEO takes a company live, its sales are `held` and never sent automatically. The view maps rawStatus 'held' to status 'pending'. fiscalLine() then shows the cashier 'Fiscal invoice: pending — will file automatically'. OrderFiscalPanel says 'No fiscal number yet — filed automatically', and the 'Reprint with fiscal QR' poll waits for a filing that will not come. Staff are told something false for every sale before go-live, which includes Monday's onboarding.
findings.fix: Branch on rawStatus === 'held' in fiscalLine() and OrderFiscalPanel. Example wording: 'Fiscal invoice: held — the company is not live with the fiscal POS yet'. Do not show the reprint-when-filed prompt for held documents.

findings.title: The order page's fiscal panel shows a permission error to roles that can open the page but not the CASHIERS-only fiscal route
findings.scenario: GET /orders/:id is ALL_STAFF, but GET /pos/orders/:id/fiscal is CASHIERS. A finance user opening /orders/[id] gets a 403. The panel then renders a red 'Fiscal invoice' box containing the 403 message instead of hiding, or showing the documents finance actually needs.
findings.fix: Treat 403 like 'no panel' (return null when the error is ApiError with status 403). Or, W1/W4 adds finance and management to the GET /pos/orders/:id/fiscal roles. lastError is already limited to staff/managers.
